=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text msg "Rosetta Code is a programming chrestomathy site, AEIOU and aeiou alike."
text vow "aeiouAEIOU"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitc writes one byte
fn emitc c uchar to void
b = new uchar 1 0
put b 0 c
emit b
end
fn isvowel c uchar to bool
for i ulong len vow
if eq c get vow i
ret true
end
end
ret false
end
fn main to int
emit msg
emit nl
for i ulong len msg
c = get msg i
if not isvowel c
emitc c
end
end
emit nl
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
Rosetta Code is a programming chrestomathy site, AEIOU and aeiou alike.
Rstt Cd s  prgrmmng chrstmthy st,  nd  lk.
</pre>
